arithmetic: IEEE binary64; no fast math; contraction disabled; Mandel shears mathematical sqrt2 in reference, binary64 sqrt2 decode in candidate
gap_meaning: Numerical resolution diagnostic relative to full Frobenius input norm, never physical-domain clipping or eigenvalue merging

metrics.value: abs(y-yref) <=512*eps*||A||F +2*denorm_min; diagonal eigenvalues additionally exact binary64 equality
metrics.value_only_derivatives: exact zero transport storage; qualifier enforcement is a separate unimplemented gate, these are not claimed derivatives
metrics.failure: Frozen expected status and unchanged prefilled output; valid recovery after injected nonfinite failures

range: Required representable outputs; highprecision reference output rounding to nonfinite binary64 requires output_range or derivative_range. Non-diagonal common-scale underflow is a diagnosed numerical failure, not an accepted material restriction.
reference: Independent centered cubic root brackets and polynomial projectors from exact stored-Mandel binary64 values; dual Decimal precision adequacy is not a rigorous interval proof
